01: At rest, one watering every two weeks is plenty.
02: Before growth starts, cut the branches that cross.
03: March: repot, trim the roots, fresh draining mix.
04: Feeding: start light, once every two weeks.
05: Bright light, no direct sun, watering resumes.
06: Heat: touch the soil each morning, water if dry.
07: Mist the leaves in the evening, away from noon sun.
08: August: keep the root ball damp, never soggy.
09: Late summer prune: take out dead wood and shoots.
10: Cut the feeding, move away from the radiator.
11: Water less, let the soil dry between two waterings.
12: Winter rest: cool light, minimal watering.
